review_protocol: Written single-pass in Draft Mode on 2026-10-18, with no interview of Chris. Every judgement call is already decided and applied in the body; the 'Open Questions and Judgement Calls' section (Q1-Q15) is a manifest of those decisions ordered by blast radius, not a queue of holes. Chris reviews by editing fullprompt.md in place, annotating with (CSH ...) markers; `/ai-design --review ontology-mapping-function-to-go-v1` then diffs the working tree against draft_commit, classifies each hunk, propagates decision changes through the body, user stories, testing decisions and taskplan, re-derives the Gotchas section, and recommits with a fresh baseline. The PRD may not advance to `ready` until review_rounds >= 1.

confront_round_1.factual_correction: Q11 claimed that setting all synonym-scope multipliers to 1.0 reproduces Type 1 exactly. It does not: Type 1 concatenates every synonym into ONE field (_candidate_fields, source.py:53) and saturates it once, whereas four scope-separated fields saturate independently. Corrected in the PRD.

decision_summary.highest_risk: Q4 -- route precedence vs RRF as the default combine mode. High confidence that equal-weight RRF should NOT be the default (the external scan's k=60 counterexample is arithmetic and matches our short-precise/long-noisy route asymmetry), but LOW confidence that precedence is the best alternative; a tuned weighted combination may beat it and only task 6 can say.

notes: Scope moved twice from the brief as given, both flagged in the PRD rather than silently absorbed. (1) The named path .../pipelines/type_4 holds a FUSION stage that computes no scores and refuses any query outside a frozen <=1000-query test manifest, so 'integrate type_4' became 'port Type 1's BM25 scorer plus Type 4's RRF kernel' (Q2). (2) 'A new API library' became 'a new capability domain on the existing @capability registry' on Chris's in-session steer, 'if there are already capabilities, build on those' (Q7). The name OntologyMapping survives as the capability domain (ontology_mapping.*) and the facade property. Adds no third-party dependency, deliberately: dependency-freedom is what stops this failing the way OntomapUtils did.
